name: 3D Essential - GameObject, ScriptObject, Prefabs, Materials
author: mihye-bang
description:
Objects are falling at different speeds based on their shape, size, and whether they meet obstacles until they fall to the ground/ fences. 

<Concepts related>
- Material, Rigidbody, and bounciness added to GameObjects 
- The main camera is adjusted and fixed (position, angle) to display falling objects better 
- Primitive objects made into one structure by nesting 
- C# Script component was added to increase the size of a GameObject
